desc:
Welcome to PISTOL DUELS, the ultimate fast-paced first person shooter on Roblox! Challenge other players in 1v1 to 5v5 FPS duels where the first to 5 wins!

🔫 Challenge other players by stepping on a duel pad!  
💰 Earn coins to unlock new pistol skins!  
📦 Open cases and collect rare and valuable skins!  
💎 Discover unique patterns, finishes, and rarities!  
🏆 Show off your skins, win streak and climb the leaderboards!	

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX & PlayStation!

👍 Like, Follow & Favorite for more updates!

⚠️ WARNING: Cheaters and exploiters will be permanently banned with no second chances. Farming wins and abusing glitches are strictly prohibited!

❤️ Inspired by RIVALS, Sniper Duels and Pistol 1v1!
